name: FalconBeat
author: GraphicHealer
description: A self-hosted way to play your show's audio on visitors' devices, in sync with the lights using a FalconBeat server.

privacy.summary: Sends your show audio and play/pause commands to the FalconBeat server you configure, so visitors can listen in sync on their own devices.

sends.what: audio files (incl. video soundtracks), playback commands, show info, server token
sends.why: to let visitors' devices play the show audio in sync with the lights

systemChanges.what: runs a Python daemon (falconbeatd) while fppd runs; local unix socket only
daemon control channel is a unix-domain socket under plugindata (loopback TCP fallback on non-Linux dev hosts) - not reachable off-host
sets restartFlag on install/upgrade so fppd reloads the new plugin code

privacy.other: Secrets are stored mode-0600 under plugindata, outside the shared config directory; the daemon listens only on a local unix socket. Show info is the name/tagline/host/schedule/location/description/links/public URL you configure; blank name and tagline fall back to FPP's HostName and HostDescription.
